cases.source:
@verbose 0.1.0
concept Input
  @intention: "Bound numeric storage comparison inputs"
  @source: scratch.intent:1
  fields:
    x : number [-10, 10]
    y : number [1, 5]
rule entry
  @intention: "Reuse dead numeric storage while protecting live values"
  @source: scratch.intent:1
  input:
    i : Input
  output:
    out : number
  logic:
    out = i.x + i.y
  proofs:
    purity:
      reads : [i.x, i.y]
      calls : []
    termination:
      bound : 10000
  hints:
    overflow : [-1000000, 1000000]
